description: This source file defines a React functional component named ScratchpadOption, which renders a button used in the application's sidebar to select the scratchpad folder. It accepts props to determine active state and a function to swap folders.

methods.name: ScratchpadOption
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a button which, when clicked, triggers the swapFolder function with Folder.SCRATCHPAD and visually indicates active state.
